calculation.expression: lag1((log(close/close[-20])) / (sqrt(mean(min(log_return,0)^2 over 40 sessions))*sqrt(252))) * I(10-session mean cross-sectional breadth >= 0.50)
calculation.description: Twenty-session log momentum divided by downside semideviation over 40 sessions, activated only when at least half of the available tradable assets have positive 20-day returns on average over the prior 10 sessions. The complete signal is lagged one session to prevent lookahead.
